notes.text: The heading abbreviates its title as ר׳, rendered R', while the target explicitly writes רב, Rav. Yose and Yosef remain distinct supplied forms. The pointer alone does not justify transferring the target’s full title or establishing identity; the heading was recorded as provisional.
